parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the event source.

parameters.description: The event bus with which the event source is associated.

parameters.name: EventSourceName
parameters.description: The name of the event source.

parameters.name: ExternalSourceConfig
parameters.description: The configurations of the external data source.

parameters.name: ExternalSourceType
parameters.description: The type of the external data source.

parameters.name: LinkedExternalSource
parameters.description: Specifies whether to connect to an external data source.

parameters.name: SourceHttpEventParameters
parameters.description: The parameters that are configured if the event source is HTTP events.

parameters.name: SourceKafkaParameters
parameters.description: The parameters that are configured if the event source is Message Queue for Apache Kafka.

parameters.name: SourceMNSParameters
parameters.description: The parameters that are configured if the event source is Message Service (MNS).

parameters.name: SourceRabbitMQParameters
parameters.description: The parameters that are configured if the event source is Message Queue for RabbitMQ.

parameters.name: SourceRocketMQParameters
parameters.description: The parameters that are configured if the event source is Message Queue for Apache RocketMQ.

parameters.name: SourceScheduledEventParameters
